    <div class="activityHead">
  <h2>KITESURF LESSONS</h2>
  <div class="sub">Enjoy worry free & safe kitesurfing lessons at ParosKite!</div>
  </div>
  <div class="activityLessons">

  <div class="activityLessonsIntroduction flx">

  <div class="activityLessonsLeft"><div class="visual" style="background-image:url(https://www.paroskite.com/media-assets/kitesurf-intro-visual-2026.jpg);"></div></div>
  <div class="activityLessonsRight">
  <h2>Learn to Kitesurf in Paros</h2>
<p>Paros Kite is situated in a <strong>prime location for kitesurfing</strong> on the world-renowned kite beach of Pounda on Paros. Offering perfect wind conditions and stunning shallow waters, Pounda Beach is the ultimate spot for learning kitesurfing!</p>
<p>Our instructors are all <strong>certified by major global kitesurfing associations</strong> and our teaching philosophy is based on internationally recognised kitesurfing lesson guides. Choose from our range of learning levels/packages including: Beginner (Level 1), Intermediate (Level 2), Independent (Level 3), or Zero to Hero (all levels).</p>
<p>We offer <strong>semi-private lessons</strong> (2 students to 1 instructor), <strong>private lessons</strong> (1 student to 1 instructor), and <strong>VIP lessons</strong> (specially tailored for you). If you are uncertain which level is best for you or have any further inquiries, <a href="https://www.paroskite.com/contact-us/">feel free to contact us for more details!</a></p>
  </div>
  </div>

  <div class="activityRentalsComponent activity" id="activityrental">

  <div class="activityRentalsInner">
  <div class="activityHead">
    <h2>KITESURF RENTALS</h2>
  <div class="sub">ParosKite has all the gear you need</div>
  </div>

  <div class="activityRentals">

  <div class="activityRentalsIntroduction flx rev">
    <div class="activityRentalsLeft"><div class="visual" style="background-image:url(https://www.paroskite.com/media-assets/kitesurf-rentals-visual-2026.jpg);"></div></div>
  <div class="activityRentalsRight">
  <h2>Focus on your surfing, not your gear</h2>
<div class="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
<div class="react-scroll-to-bottom--css-mpbsq-79elbk h-full dark:bg-gray-800">
<div class="react-scroll-to-bottom--css-mpbsq-1n7m0yu">
<div class="flex flex-col items-center text-sm dark:bg-gray-800">
<div class="group w-full text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-100 border-b border-black/10 dark:border-gray-900/50 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-[#444654]">
<div class="text-base gap-4 md:gap-6 md:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-xl xl:max-w-3xl p-4 md:py-6 flex lg:px-0 m-auto">
<div class="relative flex w-[calc(100%-50px)] flex-col gap-1 md:gap-3 lg:w-[calc(100%-115px)]">
<div class="flex flex-grow flex-col gap-3">
<div class="min-h-[20px] flex flex-col items-start gap-4 whitespace-pre-wrap">
<div class="markdown prose w-full break-words dark:prose-invert light">
<p>Reluctant to transport your equipment due to an already full suitcase or concerns about <strong>excess baggage fees</strong>? Or perhaps you have a kite or board that isn&#8217;t the right size, and you&#8217;re eager to experiment with something new, like a surfboard or hydrofoil?</p>
<p>Worry no more! ParosKite has the <strong>perfect solution for you</strong>. We offer rental services for kites, boards, and complete gear sets, allowing you to customize your selection according to your needs. <strong>The possibilities are endless</strong>!</p>
<p>Choose from an array of <strong>brand new equipment</strong> provided by leading brands like <strong>Eleveight &amp; North</strong>. We offer various options, including the ideal kite and board size to suit your specific requirements. Plus, you have the flexibility to <strong>adjust the kite size based on the day’s wind conditions.</strong></p>
<p>Our extensive collection features a wide variety of kites including freestyle, all-around, freeride, and wave kites. We also have a diverse range of boards, including new school twin-tip, freeride, strapless surfboards, skim boards, and hydrofoils. At ParosKite, we <strong>prioritize equipment maintenance and frequent updates</strong> to guarantee the highest quality for our customers.</p>
</div>

  <div class="activityLevelsComponent activity" id="activitylevels">
  <div class="levelsWrp">
  <div class="activityLevelsInner">
  <div class="activityHead">
  <h2>LESSONS & LEVEL DESCRIPTIONS</h2>
  <div class="sub">PAROSKITE KITESURF LESSONS LEVEL PLANS</div>
  </div>
    <div class="levelsNav flx"><div class='lvTab'><a href='#' data-sld='0' class='active'>KITESURF LEVEL 1</a></div><div class='lvTab'><a href='#' data-sld='1'>KITESURF LEVEL 2</a></div><div class='lvTab'><a href='#' data-sld='2'>KITESURF LEVEL 3</a></div></div>
  <div class="levelsSlider">
  <div class="levelsSlicked">
  <div><div class='sld flx'>
  <div class='lvlLeft'><img src='https://www.paroskite.com/media-assets/kitesurf-level-1-visual-2026.jpg' class='resp'></div>
  <div class='lvlRight'><div class='lvlContentIn'><h2>KITESURF LEVEL 1 – BEGINNER (4 HOURS)</h2>
<p>Studying and understanding the winds and the suitable winds for kitesurfing</p>
<ul>
<li>Setting up the kite</li>
<li>Controlling the kite</li>
<li>Studying and understanding safety systems and its application in the real situation</li>
<li>Studying and understanding international safety communication signs</li>
<li>Launching and landing the kite in the safety zone</li>
<li>Discovering of the Power Zone</li>
</ul>
</div></div>
  </div></div><div><div class='sld flx'>
  <div class='lvlLeft'><img src='https://www.paroskite.com/media-assets/kitesurf-level-2-visual-2026.jpg' class='resp'></div>
  <div class='lvlRight'><div class='lvlContentIn'><h2>KITESURF LEVEL 2 – INTERMEDIATE (4 HOURS)</h2>
<ul>
<li>Discovering the dynamic traction of the kite</li>
<li>Powering strokes &amp; Body dragging with the kite</li>
<li>Relaunch the kite in the water (learning how to make the kite fly again when it hits the water)</li>
<li>Recovering the board</li>
<li>Generating the speed</li>
</ul>
</div></div>
  </div></div><div><div class='sld flx'>
  <div class='lvlLeft'><img src='https://www.paroskite.com/media-assets/kitesurf-level-3-visual-2026.jpg' class='resp'></div>
  <div class='lvlRight'><div class='lvlContentIn'><h2>KITESURF LEVEL 3 – ADVANCED (5 HOURS)</h2>
<ul>
<li>Positioning your feet on board</li>
<li>Stabilizing your body and kite</li>
<li>Generating gentle power for standing up on the board</li>
<li>Generating constant power for standing up and riding</li>
<li>Recovering your board in deep water</li>
<li>Riding both sides and making first transitions</li>
</ul>
</div></div>
  </div></div>  </div>
  </div>
  </div>
  </div>
   </div>

    <div class="thingsToKnowComponent">
  <div class="ttkInner">
  <div class="headBlock"><h2>THINGS TO KNOW</h2></div>
  <div class="ttkCols flx">
  <div class='ttkCol'><div class='ttkColInner'><h4>KITE LESSONS – GENERAL</h4>
<ul>
<li>All Semi-private courses are 2 persons with shared kite/board and one instructor.</li>
<li>Every Level has one hour of theoretical content which is given on the beach or in the classroom, depending on the wind condition</li>
<li>Non-show/delayed customers who have pre-booked and prepaid lesson time will forfeit their lesson.</li>
<li>Breaks are not included in lessons. If a customer requests for a break, it will be counted as lesson time.</li>
<li>In all prices, rescue service and the gear needed are included.</li>
</ul>
</div></div><div class='ttkCol'><div class='ttkColInner'><h4>KITE LESSONS – PRICING</h4>
<ul>
<li>50% of the course fee is payable on arrival and the following 50% on completion of half of the course.</li>
<li>On non-completion of courses, you will be charged the highest applied hourly rate for any course or lesson.</li>
</ul>
</div></div><div class='ttkCol'><div class='ttkColInner'><h4>KITE LESSONS – REFUNDS</h4>
<ul>
<li>On completion of 80% of the practical part of the course, no refund will be given.</li>
<li>Cash payments will be refunded in cash minus the vat. Credit card payments cannot be refunded in cash and must be redeemed in goods from the store or in lesson vouchers.</li>
</ul>
</div></div>  </div>
  </div>
  </div>
